title: Devices on the network
search_ph: Search by name, IP, MAC or vendor
no_events: Every device that joins or leaves the network will show up here.
ev_new: {name} joined the network for the first time
empty_body: A scan runs automatically every {n} seconds. You can start one now.
no_match: No devices match the current search or filter.
ports_empty: Devices appear here after the first scan.
f_known_hint: Unconfirmed devices stay in the "Unknown" filter until you confirm them.
confirm_remove: Remove "{name}" from the list? Its history is deleted, and it will come back as a new device if a later scan finds it.
conn_lost: Cannot reach the server. Retrying automatically.
random_hint: This device uses a randomised MAC address for privacy, so it may appear as a new device if it changes its address.
self_hint: This is the machine LanWatch runs on.
n_net_narrowed: The detected network {detected} is large, so only {scanned} is scanned. Set {var} to scan more.
n_net_undetected: Could not detect the local network. Set {var1} or {var2}.
n_subnet_invalid: Subnet {subnet} is invalid and was ignored.
n_subnet_too_large: Subnet {subnet} is wider than /16 and was ignored.
n_arp_no_permission: ARP scanning needs {cap}, so the neighbour table is used instead and may be less accurate. Run the container with {mode} and {capadd}.
